name: Eye of Vecna

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

summary: Vecna's eye: Truesight 120 ft and X-ray vision, and dreadful spells (DC 18), for one who gouges out their own eye.
text: Seldom is the name of Vecna spoken except in a hushed voice. Vecna was, in his time, one of the mightiest of all wizards. Through dark magic and conquest, he forged a terrible empire. For all his power, Vecna couldn't escape his own mortality. He began to fear death and take steps to prevent his end from ever coming. To attune to this artifact, you must gouge out your own eye and press the artifact into the empty socket. While attuned, you have Truesight out to 120 feet and you can see through solid matter as a Ring of X-ray Vision. You can cast each of the following spells (save DC 18) from the Eye once per dawn: Clairvoyance, Crown of Madness, Disintegrate, Dominate Monster and Eyebite. The Eye has one minor beneficial, one major beneficial, one minor detrimental and one major detrimental property. If the Eye is ever removed, it whispers until you return it.
